variants.headline: Assembly votes down government bill
variants.body: A government bill has been voted down in the Colonial Assembly. Working people's needs belong at the centre of this discussion, rather than outside its political argument.

variants.headline: A proposal meets its parliamentary limit
variants.body: The Assembly has rejected a bill put forward by the government. Working people's needs belong at the centre of this discussion, rather than outside its political argument.

variants.headline: Government legislation fails the vote
variants.body: A proposed government bill has failed in the Assembly vote. Working people's needs belong at the centre of this discussion, rather than outside its political argument.
